assets.name: lobed-floral-blue-scroll
assets.description: A long curling blue foliate scroll with red flowers, green lobed leaves and small blue and red terminals.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection
provenance.title: Decorated initial O
provenance.object_identifier: Lewis E M 13:13 Decorated initial O
provenance.image_rights: Public Domain Mark 1.0; item record explicitly places images in public domain

extraction.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / faithful historical foreground extraction. Edit target: the supplied original manuscript detail. Extract Only the entire connected blue interior vine-scroll with its two orange flowers, two green lobed leaves and two small blue terminal leaves. Remove the large pink O letter, flat gold background and separate dots. Preserve all six foliage terminals and original blue winding stem, all opaque white painted highlights; real openings must be transparent. Keep the exact original pose, shapes, colors, proportions and fine ink or painted lines. Output on a genuinely transparent background, with small transparent padding. Remove lettering, parchment, stains, chart, ruler and surrounding ground color. No new details, reconstruction, modern redraw, shadows, glow, smoothing or background rectangle.
extraction.method: AI-assisted foreground extraction; transparent alpha retained, resolution capped to source region and transparent exterior trimmed.
extraction.source_pixels_redrawn: AI extraction may alter scan texture, tones or small contours; compare against the retained original source.

review.notes: Compared original curling blue stem, red/green blossoms and blue/red terminals. Gold oval and surrounding initial background removed; blossom interiors retained opaque.

previous_review.notes: Original motif compared with extraction on white and dark backgrounds: source pose, principal painted shapes, terminals and pale highlights retained. Actual openings cleared; initial glyph and flat gold/black fields removed. AI-assisted extraction approximates paint texture and some small contours.
